regions.today: Sunny spells and scattered heavy showers today. A blustery day, in fresh and gusty westerly winds, easing later. Cool with highest temperatures of 11 or 12 degrees.
regions.tonight: Showery rain early tonight. Drier, clearer but colder weather will follow later. Lowest temperatures of 1 to 4 degrees, in light to moderate southwest winds.
regions.tomorrow: Thursday will be dry for much of the day with hazy sunny spells. However, cloud will increase through the afternoon with persistent rain pushing up from the south in the evening. The rain will turn heavy with some localised flooding possible in south Leinster. Light to moderate southerly winds increasing moderate to fresh easterly later. Highest temperatures of 12 or 13 degrees.
